_comment: The question coverage-check.yml asks jev, in shadow, beside Haiku's
'Decided by the human'). A two-option choice, because a choice carries a
confidence and a noul does not. The state is the task's acceptance
criteria and the test files the PR changes (agentlib.coverage.jev_state).
Nothing acts on the answer. Keys starting with _ stay local.

all_pinned.instructions: Is every acceptance criterion in the state pinned by at least one of the tests shown, meaning a test that would fail were that behaviour missing or wrong?

criteria.yes: Every acceptance criterion has at least one test that would fail if its behaviour were missing or wrong.
criteria.no: At least one acceptance criterion has no test that would fail if its behaviour were missing or wrong.

all_pinned._why: The yes/no that Haiku's per-criterion answer also implies, so the two can be compared run by run.
